title: Checkpoint completeness: the solver journal carries every auxiliary state and the design checkpoint carries the optimizer, projection, generator, waveform and fingerprint states

solver_scenes: cpml: tests/test_differentiable.py::project(steps=13), 2D 16 x 15, CPML on every wall, float64, epsilon 1.7 (E, H and 16 psi segments)
faces: tests/test_pmc_general.py::scene with walls (pml, pmc), (pmc, pml), (pec, pmc), 10 x 10 x 6 cells, float64, voxelized diagonal epsilon (E, H, psi segments, stored E and H face banks)
ade: the cpml scene through StreamedDispersiveSimulation with two poles (E, H, psi segments, P and Q banks in the x-first slab layout)
fixture.policy: slab width 4 (3 for faces), temporal depth 3, checkpoints 1, local checkpoints 1, host banks, CPU tiles, restart_every_blocks 1
fixture.optimization: DensityParameterization 16 x 15, density mode, truncate filter radius 0.15 um, beta 1 advanced to 2 at the third iteration, eta 0.5, float64; Adam lr 0.05; objective sum over monitors of a torch.rand weight times the squared signals; four iterations with a journal per iteration and a design checkpoint per update; the interrupted run raises after the twelfth transpose (third iteration, two transposes done)

reference_method: behavioural: the host state tuple built independently by _StreamedExecution.host and advanced two blocks by the slab operator; the uninterrupted optimization run in the same process with the same seed

observables.name: record_arrays
observables.definition: the array descriptions of the forward record after two blocks against the host state tuple

observables.name: restored_state
observables.definition: difference between the arrays loaded from the record and the state reached by advancing the host state two blocks

observables.name: history_agreement
observables.definition: difference of objective, gradient norm, beta, random weight, final design and Adam moments between the resumed and the uninterrupted optimization

observables.name: refusal
observables.definition: the state named by the ValueError of a checkpoint lacking it

acceptance.solver_states: the forward record holds exactly len(host.state())+1 arrays: E, H, one psi per CPML segment, every stored E and H face bank, and for ADE the P and Q banks, each with the state's shape, dtype and byte count and a 64-character SHA-256; loading the record reproduces the two-block state bitwise; the forward resume and the backward resume reproduce the uninterrupted signals and gradients bitwise (rtol 0, atol 0)
acceptance.optimizer_states: the resumed optimization reproduces the uninterrupted history bitwise on CPU: objectives, gradient norms, beta, the torch.rand weights, the final design and the Adam exp_avg, exp_avg_sq and step
acceptance.named_states: DesignCheckpoint carries iteration, parameters, optimizer, projection, rng, waveform, fingerprint and history; a checkpoint lacking any one of them is refused with that name; a checkpoint written for another plan or other options (restart_key differs), another effective waveform, a damaged file (checksum or byte count) or another filter configuration is refused with the cause named
acceptance.source_of_limits: bitwise equality on CPU (stricter than proposed_thresholds discrete_dimensionless_fp32); counts are exact

not_yet_covered: CUDA generator states are saved when CUDA is available but the optimization test runs on CPU
ADE face banks (a dispersive scene with stored PMC faces)

the solver journal's own contract remains journal_contract (project hash, epsilon hash, options, runtime sources, torch), as recorded for G1-04; restart_key is the fingerprint of the design checkpoint

applicability: Streamed restart journals and DesignCheckpoint on one workstation, CPU; the optimization loop of the test is the reference pattern (a journal per iteration, a checkpoint per update).
notes: Declared on branch g5-restart after torchfdtd/design_checkpoint.py was added; no fixture-specific budget.
